root_causes.description: Rendered API configuration is causally responsible for request failures.
Provider retries for one logical order version use unstable business identity.
API capacity is causally responsible for peak request failures.
A consumer retry/deduplication contract causes duplicate fulfillment.
Mixed invalidation leaves a stale stable-key or legacy cache alias.
Strict read-after-write traffic is incorrectly served from a lagging replica.
Transport instability causally explains the incident.
Connection pool starvation causally explains the incident.

actions.description: Replace only the API pod whose rendered config is proven causal.
Reuse one order-version business key across provider retries.
Increase API capacity after a controlled capacity intervention proves causality.
Replace the consumer whose replay semantics are proven causal.
Invalidate both legacy and stable-key cache aliases.
Route strict read-after-write traffic to the primary.
